ios.desc:
Products you already own get pulled from shelves for contamination, undeclared allergens, or safety defects, and most people never find out in time. Recall Watch fixes that.

We track official FDA and USDA recalls and send them to your phone, so you can act before something in your kitchen, medicine cabinet, or pet's bowl becomes a problem.

WHAT YOU GET

- Recall alerts across food, medicine, household items, pet products, and more
- Product photos right on the recall card, so you can spot what's affected fast
- Detailed pages with FDA and USDA info, risk levels, affected states, and company contacts
- Search any product or company by name to see if it's been recalled
- Filter by time range, location, category, or risk level
- Save recalls to check on later
- Alerts tuned to what you actually buy, set once during a quick setup

HOW ALERTS WORK
We check for new FDA and USDA recalls twice a day, morning and evening. When we find one that matches your filters, you get a push notification shortly after, usually within minutes of our scan. No noise, no digests to dig through.

WHY IT MATTERS
Recalls slip by unnoticed all the time, even for undeclared allergens, bacterial contamination like Listeria or Salmonella, unsafe ingredients, defective products, and pet items. Recall Watch puts that safety information in your pocket so you can protect the people and pets you care about.

Download Recall Watch and stay one step ahead of the next recall.

quotes.text:
Hi HN,

I’m Giovanna, a designer who built Recall Watch, an app that aggregates real-time recall data from the USDA and FDA.

It covers food, pets, household products, medical devices, and supplements — all displayed in a clean, modern interface.

The motivation: government recall websites are outdated and hard to navigate, and there’s no reliable way to receive recall alerts. Most people only hear about them sporadically — through the news or social media — which makes it easy to miss something important.

Features:

• Real-time USDA + FDA recalls

• Risk levels (High / Moderate / Low / Advisory)

• Clean, card-based interface

• Save recalls for later

This is my first app launch — I’d love feedback or thoughts on how to take it further.
